title: PipeCraft Configuration
description: Configuration schema for PipeCraft CI/CD workflow generator. Supports trunk-based development with domain-based change detection, semantic versioning, and branch promotion.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation

ciProvider.description: CI/CD provider platform. Currently 'github' is fully supported, 'gitlab' support is planned.

mergeStrategy.description: Git merge strategy for branch promotions. 'fast-forward' requires linear history, 'merge' creates merge commits.

requireConventionalCommits.description: Whether to enforce conventional commit message format (https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).

initialBranch.description: The first branch in the promotion flow (typically 'develop' or 'dev'). Must be first in branchFlow.

finalBranch.description: The final production branch (typically 'main' or 'master'). Must be last in branchFlow.

branchFlow.description: Ordered list of branches in the promotion flow from initial to final. Must start with initialBranch and end with finalBranch.

autoPromote.description: Controls how a promotion PR is merged, not whether one is opened. PipeCraft opens the promotion PR either way: true merges it automatically once checks pass, false leaves it for a human to merge. No value here stops promotion PRs from being created — to stop promoting to a branch at all, remove it from branchFlow.

mergeMethod.description: Git merge method for auto-merge operations. Can be set globally or per-branch.

bumpRules.description: Mapping of commit types to semver bump levels.

semver.description: Semantic versioning configuration. Maps conventional commit types to version bump levels.

domains.description: Domain definitions for monorepo path-based change detection. Each domain represents a logical part of the codebase.

packageManager.description: DEPRECATED: This field is no longer used. PipeCraft now supports language-agnostic workflows.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version for generated workflows. Accepts a major (e.g. '22') or an exact version (e.g. '22.18.0').

pnpmVersion.description: pnpm version for generated workflows. Accepts a major (e.g. '10') or an exact version (e.g. '10.6.2').

runtime.description: Runtime tool versions for generated CI/CD workflows. Drives the NODE_VERSION / PNPM_VERSION workflow env vars without hand-editing generated files.

actionSourceMode.description: How workflows should reference PipeCraft actions. 'local' copies actions to .github/actions/, 'remote' references published marketplace actions.

actionVersion.description: Version/tag to use when actionSourceMode is 'remote'. Pins workflows to a specific action version.

skipIfUnchanged.description: Skip regeneration if config hash hasn't changed.

forceRegenerate.description: Force regeneration even if hash matches.

watchMode.description: Enable watch mode for automatic regeneration on config changes.

hashAlgorithm.description: Hashing algorithm for detecting config changes.

cacheFile.description: Path to cache file storing previous config hash.

ignorePatterns.description: Patterns to ignore when calculating config hash.

conventionalCommits.description: Use conventional commits for version calculation.

autoTag.description: Automatically create git tags for new versions.

autoPush.description: Automatically push tags to remote after creation.

bumpRules.description: DEPRECATED: Use semver.bumpRules instead. This field is ignored if semver.bumpRules is present.

autoMerge.description: DEPRECATED: Use autoPromote instead. This is an alias for backwards compatibility.

paths.description: Glob patterns matching files in this domain. Changes to these paths will trigger domain-specific jobs.

description.description: Human-readable description of the domain's purpose.

prefixes.description: Job prefixes to generate for this domain (e.g., ['test', 'deploy', 'lint']).
